subject: Talk To Me Doja (TikTok trend)
query: what is the talk to me doja trend
title: What is the Talk to Me Doja trend? The shy anime sway dance
answer: "Talk to me Doja" is a November 2026 TikTok dance trend. People copy a bashful swaying dance from the first episode of the 2015 anime "Yamada-kun and the Seven Witches," set to a sped-up clip of Doja Cat's song "Like That." The caption is a playful shout-out to the singer, not a hidden code.
body:
The trend is simple: creators film themselves doing a nervous little sway, hands tucked under the chin, usually next to the original anime clip in a side-by-side video under 15 seconds. The on-screen caption reads "talk to me Doja" (early versions said "speak to me Doja"). The phrase itself doesn't mean much; it's a cute, joking way of acting flustered, as if the singer had just spoken to you. Typical captions: "me when the sped-up Doja sound comes on" or "POV: you finally learned the sway."

The dance comes from "Yamada-kun and the Seven Witches," a high school body-swap comedy anime that aired in 2015. In the first episode, one character, stuck in the other's body, is asked out and does an awkward, shy dance to keep up the disguise. According to Know Your Meme, a TikTok creator paired that clip with the sped-up Doja Cat sound on Nov. 7, 2026, and dance versions took off on Nov. 9 before spreading to Instagram Reels.

It went viral because it's easy and low-stakes: no complicated choreography, no props, and it works alone, with friends or with a partner. The side-by-side format also rewards accuracy, so people compete to match the anime character's exact sway, and anime fans keep sharing the original scene.

For parents: the trend itself is a harmless, cute dance. As with any TikTok sound, the full song behind the clip may contain lyrics you'd want to preview yourself, but the trend uses only a few seconds of it.
in_the_news: The trend began on TikTok on Nov. 7, 2026, and Know Your Meme published an explainer on Nov. 18 as it spread to Instagram.

faq.q: What song is used in the Talk to Me Doja trend?
faq.a: A sped-up clip of Doja Cat's "Like That." The trend uses only a few seconds of the song.

faq.q: What anime is the Talk to Me Doja dance from?
faq.a: "Yamada-kun and the Seven Witches" (2015), episode one, where a body-swapped character does a shy dance after being asked out.

faq.q: Does "talk to me Doja" mean something rude?
faq.a: No. It's a playful caption pretending the singer is talking to you, which is why the dancer acts bashful.

faq.q: How do you do the Talk to Me Doja dance?
faq.a: Tuck your hands under your chin and sway side to side shyly, matching the anime character's timing. Most people post it beside the original clip.
